why: Both concern neighbourly restraint and space, and the Ace Attorney border item mixes agreed border dealings with unasked restraint.

why.T3-038: The item builds and reports the wordmark's progress (Ace done, finishing T, adding r/, repairing Y), not merely calling hands or settling a design.

why.T3-009: The concepts mark the room's own finished/accomplished work with repeated 'we did it' and restored-sign celebration.

why.T3-091: The concepts establish a shared plan/name and a sign link for coordinating blue, rather than merely explaining or recruiting; they push one coordination scheme.

why.T3-020: The item chooses and changes a starting spot/location (pick a starting space, finger, changed location, near the sign).
why.T3-038: It also places first pixels and reports small progress (first pixel, seven pixels, making progress with a friend).

multiplacement_log.why_not_one: T3-020 carries choosing/changing the spot but not the placing and progress reports of the first pixels.
multiplacement_log.why_this_one: C0222192, C0050073, C1257918 and C0404006 place or report the first pixels and small progress.
multiplacement_log.dispensable: T3-038; dropping it would lose the first-pixel and small-progress side of the item.

why.T3-010: The item works out crowded borders with neighbours through thanks, stop requests, warnings, apologies, agreement-seeking and asking PictureGame for r/ spaces.
why.T3-024: It also has restraint kept by the room's own choice: not intruding on the kiwi and telling people not to touch the cyan box.

multiplacement_log.why_not_one: T3-010 carries border dealings and requests with neighbours but not restraint kept by the room's own choice without a deal.
multiplacement_log.why_this_one: C0023041, C1119765 and C0079581 spare others' work unasked (do not intrude on kiwi, leave it be, do not touch the cyan box).
multiplacement_log.dispensable: T3-024; dropping it would lose the unasked restraint toward the kiwi and cyan box.

why.T3-084: The item asks neighbouring groups for help/mutual support (Danganronpa support, mutual completion, thanks for help).
why.T3-035: It also requests space or permission from a host (Rainbow Road permission, moving Phoenix for Saitama, sharing space).

multiplacement_log.why_not_one: T3-084 carries asking other rooms for help with the work but not the requests for permission or space from a room that holds it.
multiplacement_log.why_this_one: C1483291, C1055042, C1114615 and C1350262 ask for space/permission or sharing room with a host/neighbour.
multiplacement_log.dispensable: T3-035; dropping it would lose the permission/space-request side.

why.T3-029: The concepts grieve the lost Apollo work after the close (fell, half-head, extremely salty).

why.T3-006: The item calls attacks and tactics against rival colours (red, rainbow, green) to destroy or overrun them.
why.T3-171: It also aims to spread/turn territory blue (grow empire to red borders, turn He-Man and Green Lattice blue, guerrilla against green).

multiplacement_log.why_not_one: T3-006 carries calls to attack and erase rivals but not the aim of spreading or converting territory to blue.
multiplacement_log.why_this_one: C0800294, C0056200, C1392950 and C1192620 treat blue's spread/territory as the aim rather than only a target to destroy.
multiplacement_log.dispensable: T3-171; dropping it would lose the colour-spread aim behind the attacks.
